components.name: Primary Sync Button
components.description: Metallic gold action button with radial glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-sync { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef08a 0%, #fbbf24 50%, #d97706 100%); color: #07050a; padding: 9px 18px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 20px -2px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.42); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-sync:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.6); }

narrative.overview: Jod-Hoon pairs the solemn authority of deep obsidian dark backgrounds with the high-voltage clarity of liquid metallic gold and electric violet cutaways. Designed for serious market monitors tracking cross-border equities across the US and Thai SET, every surface balances luxury aesthetics with high-frequency scanability.
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian canvas (#07050a) grounded with ambient violet and gold radial gradients.
Radiant metallic gold accents (#fbbf24, #f59e0b) for focal points and active triggers.
Electric violet accents (#8b5cf6, #1c1032) cutting harsh contrast.
Monospace tabular figures across all prices and percentages.

rules.name: The Gilded Focus Rule
rules.body: Gold is reserved strictly for value-bearing signals: primary actions, top performers, active selection, and the brand mark.

rules.name: The Violet Depth Rule
rules.body: Violet is used for structural separation and ambient depth, cutting the stark black-and-gold contrast.

rules.name: The Glass-Over-Void Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are translucent with backdrop-filter: blur(14px) over deep obsidian canvas.

dos: Do format all financial numerals with monospace tabular numbers (tabular-nums).
Do use gold for primary actions, active highlights, and value highlights.
Do balance black and gold with violet glass surfaces to prevent harsh visual fatigue.
Do maintain smooth 60s auto-refresh countdown and instant sync animations without layout shift.
donts: Don't use gold as a generic background for large content containers or panels.
Don't use pure solid black (#000000) for surfaces; use obsidian violet glass (rgba(16, 11, 26, 0.72)).
Don't remove tabular alignment on prices or percentage movements.
Don't let error banners clutter the UI when systems are functioning normally.
